Set the ProRes profile. This option is only valid if the codec has been set to `prores`. Possible values: "4444-xq", "4444", "hq", "standard", "light", "proxy". Default: `"hq"`. See [here](https://video.stackexchange.com/a/14715) for an explanation of possible values.

## CLI flag

```text
--prores-profile <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#proresprofile)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#proresprofile)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#proresprofile)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#proresprofile)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setProResProfile('4444');
```
